verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official MCP server as part of its Agentic Toolbox. It is explicitly intended to connect Qodo-managed skills to a remote or custom agent, workflow, or application, and exposes capabilities such as retrieving and resolving review findings. A probe confirmed the dedicated MCP docs page. Admins can govern access to the Toolbox. Missing for 10: a documented tool list beyond review findings, setup/auth/transport details, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.
